newsitem.title: USA: CILCORP sees Q4 charge for early retirement.
newsitem.headline: CILCORP sees Q4 charge for early retirement.

text.p: CILCORP Inc said on Monday its utility subsidiary, Central Illinois Light Co, will take a fourth quarter charge against earnings to reflect the cost of a voluntary early retirement incentive plan.
It said if the same percentage of eligible employees choose to participate in the current plan as in one that took effect January 1, 1996, CILCO would incur an after-tax charge of about $7.8 million.

The company said its plan is being offered to 210 CILCO employees as part of a continuing effort to improve operational efficiencies and better position itself for competition in the energy services industry.
Eligible employees have until December 31, 1996 to decide if they will participate in the plan.
The plan also will be offered for negotiation to employees represented by the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 51.

A total of 166 employees took part in the previous plan, which resulted in a $7.8 million charge against 1995's fourth-quarter earnings and an annualized cost savings of $3.4 million, the utility said.
